scenario.topic: Settle on the parade route for the town's jubilee celebration

options.name: Main Street Loop
options.upside: Passes through central commercial district with multiple viewing points.
options.concern: May cause significant traffic delays on main roads during the event.

options.name: Riverfront Avenue Route
options.upside: Offers scenic views along the river, enhancing the parade experience.
options.concern: Limited public transport access and some uneven pavement sections.

options.name: Historic District Path
options.upside: Showcases historic landmarks and quieter streets for spectators.
options.concern: Narrow streets may limit crowd size and parade float dimensions.

options.name: Parkside Boulevard Route
options.upside: Runs alongside the town park, providing open spaces for families.
options.concern: Fewer commercial areas may reduce vendor participation along the route.
